biggest_catch: $149 annual fee is NOT waived — true net is about $351; and the $300 Disney Gift Card is Disney-only credit, not cash.
catches: Never spend extra solely to chase the $1,000 threshold — only use spending you already planned.
The card carries a $149 annual fee, so the true net is about $500 minus $149 ≈ $351 before any interest.
The $300 Disney Gift Card eGift is not cash — it is only spendable at Disney.
Carrying a balance at the variable APR erases the bonus — pay in full every month.
Applying involves a hard inquiry on your personal credit report.
Eligibility: this offer is available only if you do not have this card and have not received a new Cardmember bonus for this card in the past 24 months.
Confirm the $500 offer is still current on creditcards.chase.com before applying.

steps: Open Chase's official page https://creditcards.chase.com/visa-credit-cards?iCELL=61HD and confirm the Disney Inspire Visa $500 offer is still showing.
Complete the application; Chase runs a hard inquiry when you apply.
